requirements.text: Proven experience building modern web applications with TypeScript and React, coupled with expertise in developing backend services or APIs using Node.js.
Comfort and proficiency working across frontend, backend, and integration boundaries, with the ability to drive progress even when problems span multiple layers of the stack.

Experience working with external APIs, asynchronous systems, or complex data integrations, demonstrating an understanding of how to design for imperfect inputs, evolving schemas, and operational failure scenarios.
A solid understanding of data platform concepts such as metadata, lineage, transformation, orchestration, data quality, and governance.

An approach to engineering that prioritizes product development: a strong desire to understand customer problems, test assumptions, and leverage learnings to continuously improve both the solution and the strategic plan.
Sound technical judgment, clear communication of your reasoning, and an open mind to feedback and new information.
A strong sense of ownership for the software you ship, with a commitment to testing, observability, maintainability, and enhancing the experience of customers who depend on your work.
Effective collaboration skills, enabling successful partnership with engineers, product managers, designers, customer-facing teams, and customers within a dynamic B2B product environment.
